Players Committee card image of [[Slave I, Symbol Of Fear (ALT)]] (the same image re-uploaded as a full-size GIF; recorded with that printing, not as a separate version), game text: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Power +1 for each opponent's starship here. While Jango or Boba Fett piloting, immune to attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/slaveisymboloffear_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/83cacbafbf6096e6be059d69fda34cf93fe24c68 83cacba] (19 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
